```{=html}
<p id="visitor-counter" class="visitor-counter" hidden>
  You are the <span class="visitor-count"></span> visitor!
</p>
<script>
  // "1" -> "st", "12" -> "th", "1,042" -> "nd"
  function ordinal(count) {
    var n = parseInt(String(count).replace(/\D/g, ""), 10) % 100;
    if (n >= 11 && n <= 13) return "th";
    return { 1: "st", 2: "nd", 3: "rd" }[n % 10] || "th";
  }

  // Home page visitors from Abacus (abacus.jasoncameron.dev), which returns the
  // updated count immediately. GoatCounter still tracks visits for the stats
  // dashboard (see goatcounter.html). Each browser is counted once; repeat
  // visits and local previews only read the count.
  var COUNTER = "https://abacus.jasoncameron.dev/%s/schoenecke.dev/home-visitors";

  function alreadyCounted() {
    try { return localStorage.getItem("home-visitor-counted") === "1"; } catch (e) { return false; }
  }

  function markCounted() {
    try { localStorage.setItem("home-visitor-counted", "1"); } catch (e) {}
  }

  window.addEventListener("load", function () {
    // Sit directly above the GitHub link instead of under the last section.
    var links = document.querySelector(".about-links");
    if (links) links.parentNode.insertBefore(document.getElementById("visitor-counter"), links);

    var local = ["localhost", "127.0.0.1"].indexOf(location.hostname) !== -1;
    var action = local || alreadyCounted() ? "get" : "hit";
    fetch(COUNTER.replace("%s", action))
      .then(function (r) { return r.ok ? r.json() : Promise.reject(r.status); })
      .then(function (data) {
        if (action === "hit") markCounted();
        var counter = document.getElementById("visitor-counter");
        counter.querySelector(".visitor-count").textContent = data.value + ordinal(data.value);
        counter.hidden = false;
      })
      .catch(function () {});
  });
</script>
```
